title: 365-Day 450GB (5G/4G) Prepaid SIM Plan + Bonus 12 Months OnePass Membership for $179 Delivered @ OnePass Mobile
body:
Deal: 365-Day 450GB (5G/4G) Prepaid SIM Plan + Bonus 12 Months OnePass Membership for $179 Delivered @ OnePass Mobile

[wT7KQwLT] This seems like a very good deal, anyone have experience with OnePass mobile?
[EekyLeak] It’s the kind of deal that makes you assume the worst about data collection. It’s not free but ~$15 a month and ~35GB… yeah I’m definitely subsidising that with shonky T&Cs somewhere
[bamzero] Realistically why tho? The data basically costs them nothing, the telcos all took it upon themselves to remove smaller cheaper plans in favour of charging us more for big data plans "that we all asked for" so I'm guessing a large number of its customer base uses hardly any of their quota.
If you use the free OnePass on the other hand…
[bamzero] I'm on an old plan from the Catch days. Haven't had any issues but no 5G and no data rollover.
Prob not an issue for a 12 month plan but if you already have a paid Onepass plan and sign up for a monthly SIM plan use a different email so you dont lose it if you cancel your SIM plan
[seanbaussie] I got a 365 day plan a couple of months ago and not super excited by the coverage strength. It's fine in the cbd but reduced surprisingly noticeably once i hit even just the inner suburbs.
[maddoglee] I’ve had it for the last few years. It was catch previously. I’ve been happy with it. 4G is fast enough for me. I keep it on 4G even on my phone 15
[CDG] One pass is useless after removing catch and kmart soon
[backupper1] it has lost lot of its value, now they also removed clearance items from free delivery.
[TheDukeOfNukem] Is Kmart getting taken off? I knew clearance items were, but if Kmart overall is gone, yeah, I wouldn't bother with OnePass even at $5 a year.
[Frozensage] I used it once for some stuff from bunnings, delivery took like close to a week and there wasn't really any accurate time like u get with prime. During that time I prolly drove past Bunnings 3 times. Had I known would have just bought it in person. Seems like an average service.
[bamzero] Haven't really used for Bunnings (rather my Powerpass 5% off and it's just down the road)
But for Kmart pretty much the same thing, it's 5 mins away and I can have it in my hand rather than wait and hope it gets posted quickly and from a nearby store.
So Kmart clearance items is where it's at for me, stock often not at my stores or if it says it is I still can't find it so I'll get it delivered.
So with that going away doubt I'll be renewing it when it expires.
[johnnytran] Where did you hear Kmart is being removed?
[Mild October] Kmart being removed? I thought it is just the clearance items.
[johnnytran] I thought one pass was only 4g? That’s why I’ve never signed up
[Mild October] TBH I will still switch back to 4g to stop 5g draining my phone battery.
[DaTa] Bought this pack last month with 360gb data, just ported over only real negative is no esim and city speeds seem comparable to boost mobile inner city.
